limitations: Not adjudicable here means the antecedent is unestablished, not that the conditional prediction is inherently untestable.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: In a scenario where the vast majority of AI data centers go unused, 80% or more of the funds invested in AI data center debt will be lost, because the vast majority of data centers are paid out of customer revenues.
conditions: the vast majority of AI data centers go unused

statement.excerpt: The scenario I’m talking about is one where the vast majority of AI data centers go unused, and because the vast majority of data centers are paid out of customer revenues, 80% or more of the funds invested in AI data center debt will be lost.

from_speaker: the vast majority of AI data centers go unused
funds invested in AI data center debt will be lost
our_interpretation: This is a conditional forecast: the widespread non-use scenario must occur before its loss prediction can be scored.
Unused means actual operating capacity without meaningful compute use; leased space and signed contracts are imperfect proxies.
Loss is read as aggregate invested debt principal not recovered after payments and recoveries, rather than a temporary fall in traded bond prices.
The denominator is debt investment in the relevant AI data-center population, not equity investment or all technology-company debt.
No deadline, currency, accounting basis, numerical definition of vast majority, or duration of non-use is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: After the widespread non-use condition is established, aggregate irreversible principal losses reach at least 80% of invested debt principal for the relevant population.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the condition is established, final repayments and recoveries show aggregate principal losses below 80%.
